# Third-party notice: WZHK Spectrum upstream visualizer

The bootstrap installer retrieves the source from:

```text
https://github.com/WaZaHaKa/monstercat-visualizer.git
```

The fork is based on MarcoPixel's Rainmeter Monstercat Visualizer and is licensed
under the MIT License. The installer retains the upstream `LICENSE` file and writes
`vendor/wzhk-spectrum-visualizer/UPSTREAM-SOURCE.json` with the exact cloned commit.

The TrackPrompt integration must use user-owned WZHK branding in generated render
workspaces and must not imply endorsement by, affiliation with, or ownership by
Monstercat.
